title: A4.NetworkZone
description: A network zone a shape is deployed in: on premises or cloud (level 0), the internal network or a DMZ inside one (level 1), or a private network inside that (level 2)

owner.description: the actor or role accountable for it

x-sdem-source.standard: ArchiMate 3.2 concept (confirmed via the Archi oracle; specification text login-gated)
x-sdem-source.locator: assignment (active structure assigned to behaviour or object)

owner.x-sdem-reasoning: Answers: Who is accountable for this? Accountability is the most-asked design question. No public standard defines an "owner" field: Dublin Core's rightsHolder is about rights, not accountability. Built on ArchiMate's assignment of an actor or role.

access_classification.description: how sensitive it is and who may see it

x-sdem-source.standard: Dublin Core (DCMI Metadata Terms, DCMI Recommendation 2020-01-20)

access_classification.x-sdem-reasoning: Answers: Who may see this? How sensitive is it? Dublin Core defines the field (access or security status); the four values are SDEM's common banking scale, not a standard.

inferred.description: set on a record SDEM inferred rather than a person wrote: by (sdem aid), run, rule, source, reasoning, confidence, from (the records it was inferred from), at; and, once a person agrees, status confirmed, confirmed_by, confirmed_at
inferred.x-sdem-reasoning: AID writes the records a workspace is missing into its real layer files, so an architect works in one set of files. A record SDEM inferred must never be mistaken for one a person wrote or confirmed: the mark carries the source, reasoning and confidence, and stays — with who confirmed it — once a person agrees.

sources.description: where individual attribute values came from, when they came from somewhere other than the record's own source_id: attribute name → `kind:ref` (e.g. {"integration_type": "document:DESIGN.md#4.2"}); several refs comma-separated
sources.x-sdem-reasoning: A record's source_id says where the record came from; a design often gives one fact in another section, or a second document gives it. Recording the source per attribute lets a reviewer check each value against its evidence, in the same dataset — no second store — and with the same `kind:ref` convention as source_id and the registry's evidence.

internet_facing.description: whether it is reached from the internet (a web server, an API gateway) — it belongs in a DMZ (LC-18)
internet_facing.x-sdem-reasoning: Answers: Which shapes are reached from the internet, and are they all in a DMZ?

site.description: the data centre or site the organisation runs it in — it is on premises (HS-01)
site.x-sdem-reasoning: Answers: Where is it physically? Explicit evidence that a shape is on premises; beats name matching.

cloud_provider.description: the cloud provider it runs on, by name — it is in the cloud (HS-06)
cloud_provider.x-sdem-reasoning: Answers: Which provider is it on? Explicit evidence that a shape is in the cloud.

region.description: the cloud region it runs in (e.g. region-a) — it is in the cloud (HS-06)
region.x-sdem-reasoning: Answers: Which region is it in? Explicit evidence that a shape is in the cloud.

connects.description: ids of nodes and devices on the network
connects.x-sdem-reasoning: Duplicates the within-level link a platform has to its network (RA4-37, metamodel 0.9.0); `sdem migrate` turns each listed id into that link. Deprecated: use the link.

address_range.description: the network's address ranges in CIDR notation (e.g. 10.20.0.0/16)
address_range.x-sdem-reasoning: Answers: Which address ranges does this network cover? IETF best current practice for writing address ranges; checked 2026-10-24.

zone_level.description: 0 = on premises or cloud; 1 = internal or DMZ inside one; 2 = a private network inside a level-1 zone
zone_level.x-sdem-reasoning: Answers: Which deployment, which network, which sub-network? The level of the zone in the owner's three-level structure.

zone_kind.description: on_premises or cloud (level 0); internal or dmz (level 1); private (level 2)
zone_kind.x-sdem-reasoning: Answers: Is it on premises or in the cloud; internal or internet facing? Checked against zone_level by LC-17.

attributes.x-sdem-note: undefined attributes are allowed here but reported as warnings by sdem check

x-sdem-entity.reasoning: SDEM extension: a Communication Network given a place in the deployment structure (the owner's decision, 2026-11-14 (network zones, Z1–Z6); docs/design/sdem-network-zones-design.md). Zones nest by network composition (RA4-27) and hold the shapes deployed in them (RA4-38); the connections between zones follow from the structure.
